predict.prompt: Adding 3 squares each step, how many at step 6?
predict.reveal: Step n uses 3 × n squares, so step 6 uses 18 — no drawing required.

options.label: 36 squares, because 12 × 3 = 36

options.label: You cannot know without drawing every step

widget.prompt: A pattern follows the rule "add 6", starting at 4: 4, 10, 16, 22. What comes next?

options.label: 28, because each term gains a fixed 6
options.feedback: Correct — an additive rule adds the same amount every time, so the gaps stay equal at 6.

options.label: 132, because 22 × 6 = 132
options.feedback: That applies a multiplying rule; this pattern adds 6 rather than scaling by it.

options.label: 26, because the gap shrinks
options.feedback: The gap in an additive rule never changes — every step here is exactly 6.

options.label: 44, because the pattern doubles
options.feedback: Doubling would have taken 4 to 8, not to 10; the first step already rules it out.
